name: 22nd Dynasty Charity Half Marathon
short_description: A charity half marathon with 21.1 km, 10 km and 4 km races, starting and finishing at Dynasty Hotel Miri in Miri, Sarawak, Malaysia on October 25, 2026.
ai_summary: The 22nd Dynasty Charity Half Marathon is a half marathon event scheduled for October 25, 2026, based at Dynasty Hotel Miri in Miri, Sarawak, Malaysia. The race offers a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km and a 4 km fun run, all starting and finishing at the hotel.
pros: Cash prizes ten deep in the 21 km open and veteran categories
Entry from RM95 for the 21 km, with a finisher tee for half marathoners
4am start, with route roads closed or diverted from 3am to 8am in 2025
10 km and 4 km fun run alongside the half marathon
cons: Saturated air: 94% to 100% humidity at 24°C to 25°C in 2025
21 km cut-off tightens to 3 hours 30 in 2026
No elevation profile published; one 2025 runner found the Bukit Tanjung climb very tough
research_highlights: Three race categories are offered: 21km half marathon, 10km, and 4km fun run, all starting and finishing at Dynasty Hotel Miri.

Recent editions have had very early flag-offs (around 3am-4am for the 21km) with roads closed roughly 3am-8am, covering routes like Jalan Miri-Pujut, Jalan Bintang, Jalan Sylvia, Jalan Brooke, Jalan Kubu and the Luak Esplanade area.

The event is organised by Dynasty Hotel Miri together with government departments and local NGOs, and proceeds go to charitable programmes for the underprivileged in Miri (elderly, single mothers, festive care packages).
Race pack/entry pack collection is typically held over two days (Friday and Saturday, 10am-6pm) at Dynasty Hotel before race day.
research_watchouts: No first-hand participant race reports, reviews, or running-community discussion of course conditions, crowd support, or organisation quality were found in available sources -- coverage is almost entirely from news outlets on logistics/road closures rather than runner testimony.

Road closures affect a wide swath of central Miri (Jalan Miri-Pujut, Bintang, Kipas, Sylvia, Brooke, Kingsway, Padang, Kubu, Luak/Esplanade, Melayu), so non-participants and even runners' support crews should plan around a 3am-8am window.
Given the pre-dawn 3-4am start typical of this race, runners driving in should account for early arrival and parking near Dynasty Hotel.

faqs.question: When is the 22nd Dynasty Charity Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The 22nd Dynasty Charity Half Marathon is scheduled to take place on October 25, 2026. The race is held in Miri, Sarawak, Malaysia, with Dynasty Hotel Miri serving as the venue. Runners planning to participate should note this date.

faqs.question: What distance is offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The race offers three distances: the 21.1 km half marathon, which starts at 4am, a 10 km that starts at 6.15am and a 4 km fun run that starts at 6.20am. In 2026 the half-marathon cut-off is 7.30am, and a finisher T-shirt is given to 21 km finishers only.

faqs.question: Where is the race located?
faqs.answer: The race is located in Miri, Sarawak, Malaysia, with Dynasty Hotel Miri serving as the official venue. This location serves as the base for the 22nd Dynasty Charity Half Marathon, which takes place on October 25, 2026.
